exception.justification: Justified: Destruction erases in place before unlock and release without observing secret data.

review.body: { if self . completion . is_some () { # [cfg (test)] if ! self . released && self . process . is_current () { tests :: observe_retained (self . bytes ()) ; } return ; } if self . released || ! self . process . is_current () { return ; } if ! self . pointer . is_null () { self . erase () ; # [cfg (test)] tests :: observe_erased (self . bytes ()) ; } let _ = self . release () ; }
review.item_premise: Ordinary destruction checks ownership once before touching a live mapping, erases the full allocation, and attempts best-effort unlock and unmap. Only confirmed unmap decrements the reservation; failed unmap retains it. A cached completion outcome causes no production mapping action or retry. The test-only retained observer independently checks real ownership before inspecting fixture bytes. No pointer or raw byte slice crosses an observed boundary; Home emits constant Debug and destruction returns no diagnostic.
